# A narrowing above its widening

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-narrowing-above-its-widening` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](a-narrowing-above-its-widening.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A ranking of presentations puts a narrowing above its widening by one item only where it ranks that pair otherwise than its order on the kept sets does, or the item weighs at zero or below; read right, exactly where the item weighs below zero, and zero ties.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Under any weights two courses compare as what each admits beyond the other. A net weighting counts each listed item for a course that admits it and against it; it ranks a widening higher where every added item weighs above zero, a positive weighting being its case with nothing against. (`Becoming.Weighting.beyond`, `Becoming.Weighting.size`, `Becoming.Weighting.term_split`, `Becoming.Weighting.and_swap`, `Becoming.Weighting.weighed_split`, `Becoming.Weighting.weighed_shared`, `Becoming.Weighting.weighed_split_right`, `Becoming.Weighting.add_lt_add_iff`, `Becoming.Weighting.add_le_add_iff`, `Becoming.Weighting.weighed_lt_iff_beyond`, `Becoming.Weighting.weighed_le_iff_beyond`, `Becoming.Weighting.beyond_term_zero`, `Becoming.Weighting.weighed_beyond_of_includes`, `Becoming.Weighting.ranksNet`, `Becoming.Weighting.ranksNet_iff_beyond`, `Becoming.Weighting.not_of_neg`, `Becoming.Weighting.beyond_lt`, `Becoming.Weighting.ranksNet_lt_of_widens`, `Becoming.Weighting.cond_zero`, `Becoming.Weighting.weighed_zero`, `Becoming.Weighting.weighed_lt_of_widens`)
2. A net weighting ranks a widening by one item alone as that item weighs, whatever else either course keeps: above where it weighs above zero, below where below zero, neither where at zero; so its increment at an item has the same sign in every context. (`Becoming.Weighting.WidensBy`, `Becoming.Weighting.widensOn_of_widensBy`, `Becoming.Weighting.weighed_widensBy`, `Becoming.Weighting.size_widensBy_pos`, `Becoming.Weighting.mul_lt_mul_iff`, `Becoming.Weighting.ranksNet_widensBy`, `Becoming.Weighting.ranksNet_ties`, `Becoming.Weighting.IncreasingAt`, `Becoming.Weighting.ranksNet_increasingAt`, `Becoming.Weighting.IncrementIs`, `Becoming.Weighting.increment_transfer`, `Becoming.Weighting.ranksNet_increment_alike`)
3. A ranking of presentations, plans with their wording and order, reads the sets on a pair where it ranks the two as an order on courses ranks what they keep. Read right, an order increasing at the added item never ranks the narrowing above; under a net weighting a narrowing above its widening by one item is a pair not read right or an item at zero or below, and read right it is an item below zero. (`Becoming.Weighting.ReadsSetsOn`, `Becoming.Weighting.ReadsSets`, `Becoming.Weighting.reads_increasingAt`, `Becoming.Weighting.narrower_above_net`, `Becoming.Weighting.reads_ranksNet`, `Becoming.Weighting.reads_ranksNet_widens`)
4. Read right, the sign of the order's increment from the narrower course to the wider fixes the verdict: a sign measured apart predicts the ranking exactly where it is that increment's sign in the pair's context. (`Becoming.Weighting.reads_increment_of`, `Becoming.Weighting.reads_increment`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. A finite listing of items; two-valued admission; natural weights, a net weighting as two per item, for and against; a presentation reduced to the course it keeps, its wording and order entering only through the ranking; for the one-item laws, the wider course widening the narrower by that item alone; for a sign measured apart, the premise that it is the sign of the order's increment in the pair's context.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That a ranking not reading the sets violates: a misread or a framing may favour the wider plan as well.
- That a valuer reads the sets of a case, or that its sign measured apart is the sign of its joint increment: both are premises to measure, and for an interacting order the second fails. Witness: `Becoming.Interacting.not_net`.
- That an order increasing at each item ranks a widening by several items higher where it is neither additive nor transitive.
- That an AI persona's or a person's judgment is a ranking of presentations in this sense, or its stated sign a measurement of its order's increment.
- That a weight below zero is wrong, or that widening is better: calling widening better is C, a premise.
- **Counterexample:** Framed: one item weighing one for and nothing against; a framed presentation keeping nothing is ranked above an unframed one keeping the item, so the ranking does not read the sets on that pair (Framed.framing_alone). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Weightings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Interacting: adding one item raises a course keeping nothing and lowers one keeping the other item, so its sign measured alone is not its sign jointly, and no net weighting gives that order (Interacting.increment_differs, Interacting.not_net). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Weightings.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · Encoding a desired verdict does not justify its premises. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Invariance of description and dominance (Tversky and Kahneman 1986): dominance is obeyed where transparent and violated where masked; here a dominance violation is exactly a failure of invariance on the pair or an item at zero or below. Preferential independence (Debreu 1960; Keeney and Raiffa 1976): for two-valued attributes a net weighting's increment at an item is context-free, and Interacting is an order where it is not. Separate and joint evaluation (Hsee 1996): the sign measured apart predicts the joint ranking exactly under the link premise. Reading (the AI's): the three causes thesis T5 names, a misread, a framing and a weight below zero, are the only ones; VD2's X1s and X2 measured the link holding where the sign was strongly positive, and X3 its failure for gains.
